description:
Turn your iPad into a calm, focused notebook built for Apple Pencil.

Whyboard keeps your notes organised and available without an account or internet connection. Write naturally, create nested folders, and choose the workspace that fits the idea: numbered pages or a spacious freeform canvas.

WRITE NATURALLY
• Draw with pen, pencil and marker tools
• Erase, select, undo and redo with familiar controls
• Use Apple Pencil for ink while keeping finger gestures available for navigation
• Choose paper colours that make each notebook feel distinct

STAY ORGANISED
• Create folders and nested subfolders
• Rename, move, duplicate, favourite and sort your notes
• Search your library and jump directly to a numbered page
• Work in portrait or landscape on iPad

BUILD MORE THAN HANDWRITTEN NOTES
• Add text, shapes and photos alongside your handwriting
• Import PDFs and annotate them without modifying the source file
• Export notes as PDFs when you are ready to share

YOUR NOTES, YOUR IPAD
Whyboard works offline and stores your notebook content locally. There is no account to create, no advertising and no analytics SDK. Create checksum-verified local backups whenever you want an independent copy of your library.

Whyboard requires iPadOS 18 or later.
promotionalText: Write naturally with Apple Pencil, organise notebooks in nested folders and keep every page private and available offline—no account required.
